host.title: Host
host.description: URL of the Meilisearch instance, including the protocol. For example http://localhost:7700, or the project URL of a Meilisearch Cloud project.

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Meilisearch API key. The key must be allowed the indexes.*, documents.*, settings.*, tasks.get and version actions. Leave blank only for instances that run without a master key. See the docs for more information.

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Maximum number of documents sent to Meilisearch in a single request.
